name: Industry system
script:
# Factory Floor Monitoring System
pressure_sensor = Sensor("pressure_tank")
flow_sensor = Sensor("flow_pipe")
temp_sensor = Sensor("temp_motor")
vibration_sensor = Sensor("vibration_bearing")
plc = STM32("factory_plc")
gateway = Gateway("industrial_gateway")
cloud = Cloud("aws_iot")
alarms = LED("warning_leds")
hmi = Display("control_panel")

# Industrial sensors to PLC
pressure_sensor.connect(plc)
flow_sensor.connect(plc)
temp_sensor.connect(plc)
vibration_sensor.connect(plc)

# PLC to Gateway to Cloud
plc.connect(gateway)
gateway.connect(cloud)

# Cloud back to factory systems
cloud.connect(alarms)
cloud.connect(hmi)

# Activate industrial system
plc.turn_on()
gateway.turn_on()
cloud.turn_on()
alarms.turn_on()
hmi.turn_on()
